clauses.name: Section 1.04 Right of First Refusal on IUAs
clauses.head: Section 1.04. Right of First Refusal on IUAs.
clauses.tail: value set forth in the Counter-Offer.
clauses.text: Section 1.04. Right of First Refusal on IUAs. The terms of this Section 1.04 shall apply to all Spectrum held by Licensee or any of its Affiliates during the Term, unless (1) Licensee has complied with the Section 1.02(b) Option Notice with respect to such Spectrum, and (2) the ROFR Offer (as defined below) does not call for payment of a lower price, or other terms that -8- TIZ61919.3 are more favorable to the third party, than those offered to Clearwire in connection with the Option referred to in Section 1.02(b). During the Term of this Agreement (the “ROFR Period”), Clearwire shall have a right of first refusal to use the Spectrum as set forth in this Section 1.04 and in Section 1.02(b). Upon the receipt by Licensee of any bona fide written offer (a “ROFR Offer’) to purchase, lease, use or otherwise gain any access rights with respect to any of Licensee’s Spectrum that Licensee desires to accept, Licensee shall transmit a written notice of the ROFR Offer to Clearwire (the “ROFR Offer Notice”). The ROFR Offer Notice (i) shall contain the name and address of the Person making the ROFR Offer, the payment structure therefore and a summary of all material terms of such ROFR Offer, and (ii) shall offer to Clearwire the option to enter into an IUA upon the terms and subject to the conditions of the proposed third party use or lease agreement as set forth in the ROFR Offer Notice. Clearwire shall then have the right for thirty (30) days to accept such ROFR Offer. If Clearwire accepts such ROFR Offer, Clearwire and Licensee shall enter into an UA on such terms and conditions. If after such thirty (30) day period or upon earlier written notice Clearwire does not accept such ROFR Offer, its rights hereunder as to such ROFR Offer shall terminate and Licensee may for a period of sixty (60) days following the expiration of such thirty (30) day period enter into an agreement with the original offering party on the same terms and conditions as were offered to Clearwire. If after such sixty (60) day period, Licensee does not enter such an agreement with the original offering party, the Clearwire right of first refusal described in this Section shall again apply for such timing remaining in the ROFR Period. If the ROFR Offer Notice provides that any consideration is to be paid by the third person in whole or in part in a form other than cash, Clearwire accepts the ROFR Offer, and Clearwire is able to provide or procure comparable noncash consideration using commercially reasonable efforts, Clearwire will so provide or procure such non-cash consideration. In the event Clearwire is unable to provide or procure comparable non-cash consideration, Clearwire may substitute, in whole or in part, for non-cash consideration an amount in cash fairly equivalent to the then fair market value of the non-cash consideration payable by the third person. The ROFR Offer acceptance must specify the amount of any such substitute cash consideration and the non-cash consideration for which it is intended to substitute. If Licensee disputes that the substitute cash consideration specified by Clearwire is in an amount fairly equivalent to the fair market value of the non-cash consideration payable by the third person, Licensee must within fifteen (15) days after the receipt of the ROFR Offer acceptance provide Clearwire with written notice specifying the amount Licensee considers to be fairly equivalent to the fair market value of the non-cash consideration payable by the third person (the “Counter Offer”). The question of fair market value of the non-cash consideration will be resolved pursuant to arbitration under this Agreement unless Clearwire gives Licensee . written notice within fifteen (15) days after its receipt of the Counter-Offer that Clearwire agrees to enter into an agreement containing the fair market value set forth in the Counter-Offer.

clauses.text: Section 10.10. Remedies. The Parties recognize that, in the event that a Party should refuse to perform any provisions of this Agreement, monetary damages alone will not be adequate. The non-defaulting Party shall therefore be entitled, in addition to any other remedies which may be available, including money damages, to obtain specific performance of the terms of this Agreement. Notwithstanding any other provision herein, no remedy conferred by any of the specific provisions of this Agreement is intended to be exclusive of any other remedy, and each and every remedy shall be cumulative and shall be in addition to every other remedy given hereunder or now or hereafter existing at law or in equity or by statute or otherwise. The election of any one or more remedies by a Party shall not constitute a waiver of the nght to pursue other available remedies at any time.

clauses.text: 3. FARMOUT WELL/WELLS (A) Farmee shall drill a well, hereinafter called the "test well" strictly in accordance with the following well specifications: (1) Location: Farmee's choice on Farmout Land or on a drilling unit that includes all or a portion of Farmout Lands. (2) Spudding Deadline: On or before August 31, 1996, Farmee must commence the actual drilling of the test well at the location specified above. (2) Location Fee: Prior to the commencement of each Subsequent Well on Farmout Lands or on a drilling unit containing a portion of Farmout Lands, Farmee will promptly pay Farmor a location fee of Two Thousand Dollars ($2,000.00). (3) Spudding Deadline: On or before December 31, 1996, Farmee must commence the actual drilling of two (2) Subsequent Wells, (at the locations specified above) and, at Farmee's further option, it shall continuously develop the Farmout Lands by commencing the actual drilling of a minimum of two (2) Subsequent Wells per calendar year on the Farmout Lands or lands pooled therewith, beginning January 1, 1997, and thereafter until the Farmout Lands subject hereto are fully 3 Case: 5:16-cv-00150-JMH-REW Doc #: 1-1 Filed: 05/19/16 Page: 5 of 18 - Page ID#: 30 • I developed in accordance with the terms and conditions contained herein. (4) Completion/Plugging Deadline: Within forty-five (45) days of reaching total depth in each well.

Any substitute well drilled hereunder shall be drilled subject to the same terms and conditions and to the same depth as provided for the well so lost and abandoned.

(2) If the request for Assignment has not been received by the Farmor within sixty ( 60) days after a well has been completed as a well capable of production in paying quantities, Farmee forfeits its right to receive the Assignment and shall promptly proceed to plug and abandon any well situated upon the Farmout Lands in which Farmee has failed to comply with the time frame contained herein.

clauses.name: 3(F). Default By Farmee
clauses.head: (F)   Default By Farmee: Time being of the
clauses.tail: the terms and conditions contained herein.
clauses.text: (F) Default By Farmee: Time being of the essence under this Agreement, in the event Farmee fails to commence, continue drilling or complete any well in accordance with the terms and conditions contained herein, this Agreement shall terminate except as to those Operating Rights earned in accordance with the terms and conditions as contained herein. If Farmee defaults, other than above, in the timely and proper performance of any obligations hereunder, Farmor shall have the right to terminate this Agreement by giving Farmee thirty ( 30) days written notice to cure such default. In the event such default is not cured by Farmee within thirty days of receipt of notice by Farmee, this Farmout Agreement shall terminate except as to those Operating Rights Earned in accordance with the terms and conditions contained herein and Farmee shall have no further rights hereunder, but in no event shall Farmee be relieved of the obligation to plug and abandon any wells drilled hereunder. Also, if Farmee defaults, in addition to any other available legal or equitable remedies, Farmor may elect to take over operation of (subject to the terms of Section 6 below) any well, inclusive of but not limited to any well which is scheduled to be plugged and abandoned by the Farmee, which has not yet satisfied the earning requirements of this Agreement. This Farmout shall remain in full force and effect as to those Operating Rights Earned in accordance with the terms and conditions contained herein.

clauses.name: 4. Reserved Overriding Royalty Interest
clauses.head: 4.   RESERVED OVERRIDING ROYALTY INTEREST                A.    Farmor shall
clauses.tail: royalty interest shall survive termination of this Agreement.
clauses.text: 4. RESERVED OVERRIDING ROYALTY INTEREST A. Farmor shall except and reserve in each Agreement and Assignment of Operating Rights earned hereunder an overriding royalty-interest equal to twelve and one-half percent of eight eighth's (12.50% of 8/8) of the gross proceeds received from the sale of oil and/or gas produced from wells drilled hereunder without deductions of any kind. Upon the Payout of the first two (2) wells drilled and completed as a well capable of production in paying quantities Farmor reserves the right to escalate the reserved overriding royalty of twelve 5 Case: 5:16-cv-00150-JMH-REW Doc #: 1-1 Filed: 05/19/16 Page: 7 of 18 - Page ID#: 32 • � and one half percent (12.50%) to sixteen percent (16%). Upon Payout of all other wells drilled and completed as wells capable of production in paying quantities Farmor reserved the right to escalate the reserved overriding royalty of twelve and one half percent (12.50%) to eighteen and three fourth percent (18.75%). Should there be an outstanding twelve and one half percent (12.50%) non-participating royalty on oil in favor of a third party, then Farmor shall reserve in each Agreement and Assignment of Operating Rights earned hereunder an overriding royalty equal to one and one-half percent (1.5%) of the 5gross proceeds received from the sale of oil produced from wells drilled hereunder, without deductions of any kind, with the right to escalate said overriding royalty to three and one-half percent (3.5%) upon payout of the first two (2) wells drilled and completed as wells capable of production in paying quantities and the right to escalate said reserved one and one-half percent (1.5%) overriding royalty to six and one-half percent (6.5%) upon the Payout of all other wells drilled and completed as wells capable of production in paying quantities. However, if Farmor's interest in the acreage is less than one hundred percent (100%) or the working interest or if the Farmout acreage contributes less than one hundred percent (100%) of the total unit acreage, then said overriding royalty shall be reduced proportionately. Any reserved overriding royalty interest shall survive termination of this Agreement.

clauses.name: 5(A). Notice of Abandonment / Farmor's Right to Take Over
clauses.head: 5.   ABANDONMENT OF WELLS                (A)   In the event

ABANDONMENT OF WELLS (A) In the event any farmout well is completed as non-productive of oil or gas, or as one not capable of producing oil and/or gas in paying quantities or ceases production, Farmee shall immediately give Farmor written notice of the proposed plugging and abandonment. For thirty (30) days after receipt of such written notice, Farmor shall have the right, but not the obligation, to take over the well for the purpose of conducting additional operations as it desires; except that if a drilling rig is on location, notice to plug and abandon may be given by telephone and Farmor's response period shall be limited to forty-eight (48) hours, inclusive of Saturdays, Sundays and legal holidays. In the event Farmor fails to advise Farmee of its election within the prescribed period of time, then Farmor shall be deemed to have elected not to take over such well 6 Case: 5:16-cv-00150-JMH-REW Doc #: 1-1 Filed: 05/19/16 Page: 8 of 18 - Page ID#: 33 • • and such well shall be plugged and abandoned by Farmee in accordance with the terms hereof.

clauses.name: 6. Takeover By Farmor
clauses.head: 6.   TAKEOVER BY FARMOR                           If Farmor elects
clauses.tail: date of the Farmor's succession as Operator.
clauses.text: 6. TAKEOVER BY FARMOR If Farmor elects to take over a well under the terms and conditions of Section 5. hereof, the effective date of the takeover shall be the date of approval of Farmor as the successor Operator under the applicable Commonwealth of Kentucky rules and/or regulations or when Farmor takes actual custody of the well, whichever is earlier. As soon as practicable thereafter, Farmor shall reimburse Farmee for the estimated salvage value of Farmee's salvageable equipment in and on the well, less estimated plugging costs. Farmee shall then execute an instrument of assignment conveying to Farmor its interest in said well and associated equipment. Farmee shall also assign to Farmor all of its right, title and interest, in and to, all leasehold, options, farmins, operating agreements, or other support agreements associated with the well and any Operating Rights Earned by Farmor and earned by Farmee pursuant to the terms and conditions hereunder. Farmee shall then have no further rights or obligations under this Agreement in connection with the well being taken over by Farmor, except such rights, obligations and liabilities as accrued before the effective date of the Farmor's succession as Operator.

Provided that Farmee drills and completes the test well on or before August 31, 1996, as described in Section 3(A) herein, Farmor grants Farmee a one time Right of First Refusal during the term of this Agreement for a Farmout of the acreage identified on the plat attached hereto and made a part hereof as Exhibit "B-1 ". Failure by Farmee to provide Farmor with its election in writing within said fifteen (15) day notice period shall be an indication of Farmee's election not to receive a farmout of this acreage. Debris Removal (1) Subject to Paragraphs (3) and (4), we will pay your expense to remove debris of Covered Property caused by or resulling from a Covered Cause of Loss that occurs during lhe policy period. The expenses will be paid only if they are reported to us in writing within 180 days of the date of direct physical loss or damage. (2) Debris Removal does not apply to costs to: (a) Extract “pollulants" from land or Water; or (b) Remove, restore or replace polluted land or water. (3) Subject to the exceptions in Paragraph (4), the following provisions apply: {a) The most we will pay for the total of ° direct physical loss or damage plus debris removal expense is the Limil of Insurance applicable to the Covered Properly that has sustained loss or damage. (b) Subject to (a) above, the amount we will pay for debris removal expense Is limited to 25% of the sum of the deductible plus the amount thal we pay for direct physical loss or damage lo the Covered Property that has sustained foss or damage. (4) We will pay up to an additional $10,000 for debris removal expense, for each localion, in any One occurrence of physical loss of damage to Covered Property, if One or both of the following circumstances apply: NaWIOsads © ISO Properties, Inc., 2001 (a) The total of the actual debris removal expense plus the amount we pay for direct physical loss or damage exceeds the Limit of Insurance on the Covered Property that has sustained loss or damage. (b) The actual debris removal expense exceeds 25% of the sum of the deductible plus the amounl that we pay for direct physical loss or damage to the Covered Property that has sustained loss or damage. Therefore, if (4)(a) and/or (4)(b) apply, our total payment for direct physical loss or damage and debris removal expense may reach but will never exceed the Limit of Insurance on the Covered Property lhat has sustained loss or damage, plus $10,000, (5) Examples The following examples assume thal there is no coinsurance penalty. Example #1 Limit of Insurance $ 90,000 Amount of Deductible $ 500 Amount of Loss $ 50,000 Amount of Loss Payable $ 49,500 : ($50,000 - $500) Debris Removal Expense > 10,000 Debris Removal Expense Payable % 10,000 ($10,000 Is 20% of $50,000) The debris removal expense is less than 25% of the sum of the loss payable plus the deductible. The sum of the loss payable and the debris removal expense ($49,500 + $10,000 = $59,500) is less than the Limit of Insurance. Therefore the full amount of debris removal expense Is payable in accordance wilh lhe terms of Paragraph (3). Pana Ua 4a mm Example #2 Limit of Insurance $ 90,000 Amount of Deductible $ 500 Amount of Loss $ 80,000 Amount of Loss Payable $ 79,500 ($80,000 - $500) Debris Removal Expense $ 30,000 Debris Removal Expense Payable ; Basic Amount $ 10,500 Additional Amount $ 10,000 The basic amount payable for debris removal expense under the terms of Paragraph (3) Is calculated as follows: $80,000 ($79,500 + $500) x 25 = $20,000; capped at $10,500. The cap applies because the sum of the loss payable ($79,500) and the basic amount payable for debris removal expense ($10,500) cannot exceed the Limit of Insurance ($90,000). The additional amount payable for debris removal expense is provided in accordance with the terms of Paragraph (4), because the debris removal expense ($30,000) exceads 25% of the loss payable plus the deductible ($30,000 is 37.5% of $80,000), and because the sum of the loss payable and debris removal expense ($79,500 + $30,000 = $109,500) would exceed the Limit of Insurance ($90,000). The additlonal amount of covered debris removal expense Is $10,000, the maximum payable under Paragraph (4). Thus the total payable for debris removal expense In this example is $20,500; $9,500 of the debris ramoval expense is not covered.

A Trustee may resign, and shall be fully discharged (to the extent permitted by law) from further duty or responsibility hereunder, upon giving at least fifteen (15) days advance written notice to the Board (and to the Contributing Employer | that designated him as a Trustee), or such shorter notice as the Board may accept as sufficient, in which notice there shall be stated a date when such resignation shall take effect; and such resignation shall take effect on the date specified in the notice, unless a successor Trustee shall have been appointed (as provided by Section 3.9 or Section 3.10) at an earlier date, in which event such resignation shall take effect immediately upon the successor Trustee taking office. clauses.text: 3.8 Removal of Union Trustees. The Union Trustees shall be the incumbent president, vice president and secretarytreasurer of the Union. (b) The Chairman shall preside over meetings of the Board and, additionally, shall perform such other duties as the Board may direct.

clauses.text: 6.2 Calling of Meetings. (a) There shall be at least four regular quarterly meetings of the Trustees each year, the time of such meetings to be determined by the Trustees. (b) Special meetings may be called by the Chairman or Secretary or by any four Trustees at any time by giving at least five (5) days advance written notice of the time and place of such meeting to all other Trustees. (c) Meetings may be held at any time, with proper advance notice (as prescribed by either paragraph (a) or (b) above), by telephone conference. (d) Meetings of the Trustees may also be held at any time, without notice, in person or by telephone conference; provided, that all the Trustees consent thereto. (e) The place of all regular and special meetings shall be determined by the Trustees.

clauses.text: 8.1 Appointment of Investment Managers. (a) The Board, in its sole discretion, may appoint one or more Investment Managers to manage and invest (including the power to acquire and dispose of) all or a portion of the assets of the Trust Fund. (b) In the event that more than one Investment Manager is appointed, the Board shall separately segregate, or request the Custodian to segregate, each portion of the assets constituting the account to be managed by each respective Investment Manager into a separate Investment Manager Account. (c) The Board may also direct the investment of any portion of the Trust Fund that is not subject to the management and control of an Investment Manager. In directing the investment of any portion of the Trust Fund, the Board shall have exclusive power and authority to exercise the powers set forth in Section 5.5 with respect to the Securities of other property so invested.

The Investment Manager shall also identify to the Board the person or persons authorized to give Instructions or directions to the Board on behalf of the Investment Manager (including specimen signatures). (b) The duties and responsibilities of each Investment Manager shall be expressed in writing in an agreement to be entered into and executed on behalf of the Trust Fund between the Board and such Investment Manager. Each Investment Manager so employed shall be compensated in such manner as shall be mutually agreed upon in such investment management agreement. (c) The Board shall meet periodically with any Investment Manager appointed hereby for the purpose of reviewing the activities of each Investment Manager and monitoring its investment performance, including whether the Investment Manager has complied with any Investment Guidelines that may have been promulgated by the Board (pursuant to Section 8.8).

clauses.text: 9.4 Failure to Make Employer Contributions. (a) The failure of any Employer to make Employer contributions to the Trust Fund when due shall not relieve any other Employer of its obligation to make Employer contributions. The costs and expenses incurred in the collection of Employer contributions shall be paid from the Fund. Notwithstanding the preceding sentence, upon the failure of any Employer to make Employer contributions to the Trust Fund required by the Plan, the Trust Fund or a Collective Bargaining Agreement, within ten (10) days after such payments are due and payable, the Board (or its counsel or other duly authorized designee) may compel and enforce payment in any manner it deems proper (including, without limitation, the assessment of interest, at a rate calculated in accordance with Section 9.5, from the date such payments first became due and payable). (b) In addition, the Board may require a delinquent Employer to pay a liquidated damage penalty equal to the greater of interest on, or twenty percent of, the unpaid contributions, plus all costs and expenses incurred by the Trustees arising out of the collection of such delinquent Employer contributions (including, without limitation, court costs and attor- neys’ fees).

(a) In addition to any other enforcement remedies that may exist under applicable law or any Collective Bargaining Agreement or any other agreement requiring Employer contributions to the Trust Fund, the Board is authorized and empowered to initiate whatever action or proceedings may be proper and necessary in its sole and absolute discretion for the enforcement of an Employer’s contribution obligations to the Trust Fund (including, but not limited to, proceedings at law or in equity, arbitration and any other remedies that generally would be available for the enforcement of said obligation to contribute to the Trust Fund). (b) A delinquent Employer shall be liable for any expenses incurred in effectuating such payment (including, but not limited to, arbitration expenses, counsel fees, court costs, and interest at a rate of 18 percent per annum). (ce) The obligations of the Employers hereunder to make contributions to the Plan are several and not joint, so that no Employer shall be liable or responsible for the default of any other Employer hereunder.

The Union shall not contract for any of its members nor knowingly allow any of its meme« bers to contract with any person publishing within 19 FUNDO000934 the City of New York for the performance of any of the operations set forth in Section 2 hereof at a wage rate lower than herein fixed for such operation or upon any other terms or conditions more favorable than the terms and conditions herein contained without at the same time permitting any of the Publishers, parties hereto, at any time thereafter on written notice to the Union. to make effective in his own plant such lower wage rate or any or all of such other more favorable terms or conditions. Illness, disability or partial incapacitation by reason of advanced age, during which time the man has no employment elsewhere; or 2. Service in the Armed Forces of the United States; or 3. clauses.text: SECTION 5 Shifts and Regular Working Time 6-A. A regular day’s work shall consist of 7 hours and 54 minutes or less consecutively between the period of 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., which period shall be known as the day shift.

A regular night’s work on Saturday shall consist of seven and one-half (74%) or fewer consecutive hours of work when the period shall begin at 4:00 p.m. These periods shall be known as the night shift.

clauses.text: 18-A. 4. Cost of Living Allowance: On each anniversary date of the contract, March 81, 1982, and March 31, 1983, employees covered hereunder shall receive a cost of living adjustment to the scheduled wage increases in accordance with the following formula: The Bureau of Labor Statistics Consumer Price Index (C.P.1.-W; 1967=100) for New York City, hereafter called the Index, shali be used for all measurements of the change in cost of living. Effective March 831, 1982, the amount of any cost of living adjustment shall be the percentage increase in excess of 6% in the Index for May 1982 over May 1981 (as reported in June each year) multipled by the day scales and the resultant amount shall be added to the day scales. Effective March 31, 1988, the amount of any cost of living adjustment shall be the percentage increase in excess of 6¢¢ in the Index for May 47 EIN AN tare nn AE ON UN Ee FUNDOO000948 1988 over May 1982 (as reported in June each year) multiplied by the day scales and the resultant amount shall be added to the day scales. The amount of any cost of living adjustment shall be included in computing all premiums and fringes such as pension and welfare contributions, overtime premium, night shift premium, vacation payments, holiday payment, death leave pay, paid leave, ete. In no event will a decline in the Index cause a reduction in the scale of wages or in any adjustment thereto. ; In the event that the Bureau of Labor Statistics shall fail to publish the Index or shall change its base period, the parties shall meet to discuss and apply any such new Index and its application to the cost of living allowance. If the parties are unable to agree, then the same shall be referred to arbitration.

clauses.text: 13-B. 2. (a) Such vacation credit shall be earned when an employee is working on a situation as a regular or extra employee. The spirit and purpose of this provision is to disallow the duplication of vacation credits on the same situation. Days during sick leave shall be included in the schedule of days worked for which vacations are allowed. The words “sick leave” as used herein shall include time lost by reason of any illness or 49 FUNDOO00949 accident subject to the provisions of either the Workers Compensation Act or the Publishers’— Newspaper and Mail Deliverers’ Welfare Fund; and such waiting periods as contained therein shall be counted as days worked, but in no event shall such period of disability in excess of thirty (30) weeks in the case of sickness or fifty-three (58) weeks in the case of accident, both periods including the waiting period, be counted as time worked for the purpose of vacation credits, Time spent on duty with the National Guard or on Reserve Duty shall be included in the days worked for which vacations are allowed, to a maximum of two weeks. Holidays shall be included in the days worked for which vacations are allowed. Days of vacation are not to be counted as work days. The vacation schedule shall be arranged at the convenience of the employer, but on the basis of seniority. The days of the vacation period shall be consecutive. The Union offers, if called upon, to supply men to the employers to cover the period for which vacations are allowed, who may be employed at straight-time rates. Employees receiving vacations will not be allowed to work during ‘the vacation periods; and an employee who works during vacation period shall not be entitled to vacation pay.

To elect this option, the employee must notify in writing the office of the employer by November 1 of each of the above years that he is accumulating such leave. clauses.text: SECTION 22 SHOP CONDITIONS: THE TIMES Times Carlstadt Facility 22-A. These are the final minutes of The Times-NMDU Sub-Committee. These Minutes are divided into three main chapters: I—General Memorandum Concerning Carlstadt; J]—Jurisdiction at Carlstadt; and J]]-—Over-the-Road Trucking. . The Times and the Union agree as set forth below on certain aspeets of The Times’ operations at its new facility at Carlstadt, New Jersey. Two major factors in the decision of The Times to make the large capital investment re- . Gaired by the Carlstadt facility were the need ‘go make substantial productivity gains and to meet the competitive challenge of suburban newspapers. The partics recognize that the challenge of suburban newspapers can be met only if the production and distribution of The Times are timely and meet the needs of the reader. Accordingly, The Times and the Union commit themselves to-the achievement of maximum productivity and efficiency at the Carlstadt facility consistent with the terms of this memorandum and of the contract. For any Transaction in which a Fund is acting as Buyer (or Seller, as the case may be). each reference in the Agreement and this Annex VII to Buyer (or Seller, as the case may be) shall be deemed a reference solely to the particular Fund to which such Transaction relates. as identified to Seller (or Buyer, as the case may be) by the Fund and as may be specified in the Confirmation therefor. In no circumstances shall the rights, obligations or remedies of either party with respect to a particular Fund constitute a right, obligation or remedy applicable to any other Fund. Specifically, and without otherwise limiting the scope of this Paragraph: (a) the margin maintenance obligations of Buyer and ~ller specified in Paragraph 4 or any other provisions of the Agreement and the single agreement provisions of Paragraph 12 of the Agreement shall be applied based solely upon Transactions entered into by a particular Fund, (b) Buyer's and Seller's remedies under the Agreement upon the occurrence of an Event of Default shall be determined as if each Fund had entered into a separate Agreement with Counterparty, and (c) Seller and Buyer shall have no right to set off claims related to Transactions entered into by a particular Fund against claims related to Transactions entered into by any other Fund.

(iii) | Subject to the provisions of paragraph 5.7(b)(iv) below, neither the Manager, the Servicer, nor any of its Affiliates shall receive a real estate commission in connection with such a sale. clauses.text: SECTION 2.03 Subrogation. Notwithstanding any payment made by the Guarantor hereunder or any set-off or application of funds of the Guarantor by the Facility Agent or any EGL Guarantee Agreement 4 Lender, the Guarantor shall not be entitled to be subrogated to any of the rights of the Facility Agent or any Lender against the Borrower or any other Guarantor or any collateral security or guarantee or right of offset held by the Facility Agent or any Lender for the payment of the Guarantor Obligations, nor shall the Guarantor seek or be entitled to seek any contribution or reimbursement from the Borrower or any other Guarantor in respect of payments made by the Guarantor hereunder, until all Guarantor Obligations are paid in full in cash, no Letter of Credit shall be outstanding and the Total Commitments are terminated. If any amount shall be paid to the Guarantor on account of such subrogation rights or as a contribution at any time when all of the Guarantor Obligations shall not have been paid in full in cash, such amount shall be held by the Guarantor in trust for the Facility Agent and the Lenders, segregated from other funds of the Guarantor, and shall, forthwith upon receipt by the Guarantor, be turned over to the Facility Agent in the exact form received by the Guarantor (duly indorsed by the Guarantor to the Facility Agent, if required), to be applied against the Guarantor Obligations, whether matured or unmatured, in such order as the Facility Agent may determine. Notwithstanding the foregoing, nothing herein shall prevent the reimbursement of the Guarantor in respect of any payment made by the Guarantor hereunder if such payment is permitted under Section 6.07 of the Credit Agreement.

clauses.name: SECTION 2.04 Amendments, etc. with respect to the Borrower Obligations
clauses.head: SECTION 2.04         Amendments, etc. with respect to
clauses.tail: any property subject thereto.
clauses.text: SECTION 2.04 Amendments, etc. with respect to the Borrower Obligations. The Guarantor shall remain obligated hereunder notwithstanding that, without any reservation of rights against the Guarantor and without notice to or further assent by the Guarantor, any demand for payment of any of the Guarantor Obligations made by the Facility Agent or on behalf of the Lenders may be rescinded by the Facility Agent or the Lenders and any of the Guarantor Obligations continued, and the Guarantor Obligations, or the liability of any other Person upon or for any part thereof, or any collateral security or guarantee therefor or right of offset with respect thereto, may, from time to time, in whole or in part, be renewed, extended, amended, modified, accelerated, compromised, waived, surrendered or released by the Facility Agent or the Lenders, and the Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents and any other documents executed and delivered in connection therewith may be amended, modified, supplemented or terminated, in whole or in part, as the Facility Agent (or the Required Lenders or all Lenders, as the case may be) may (with the consent of such of the Borrower as shall be required thereunder) deem advisable from time to time, and any collateral security, guarantee or right of offset at any time held by the Facility Agent or any Lender for the payment of the Guarantor Obligations may (with the consent of such of the Borrower and the Guarantor as shall be required thereunder) be sold, exchanged, waived, surrendered or released. Neither the Facility Agent nor any Lender shall, except to the extent set forth in, and for the benefit of the parties to, the agreements and instruments governing such Lien or guarantee have any obligation to protect, secure, perfect or insure any Lien at any time held by it as security for the Guarantor Obligations or for the guarantees contained in this Article II or any property subject thereto.

clauses.name: SECTION 2.05 Guarantee Absolute and Unconditional
clauses.head: SECTION 2.05           Guarantee Absolute and Unconditional. The
clauses.tail: commencement and continuance of any legal proceedings.
clauses.text: SECTION 2.05 Guarantee Absolute and Unconditional. The Guarantor waives any and all notice of the creation, renewal, extension or accrual of any of the Borrower Obligations, notice of or proof of reliance by the Facility Agent or the Lenders upon the guarantee contained in this Agreement or acceptance of the guarantee contained in this Agreement and notice of any law, regulation, decree or order of any jurisdiction or any event affecting any term of a Guaranteed Obligation; the Borrower Obligations, and any of them, shall conclusively be deemed to have been created, contracted or incurred, or renewed, extended, amended or waived, in reliance upon the guarantee contained in this Agreement; and all dealings between the Borrower and the Guarantor, on the one hand, and the Facility Agent and the Lenders, on the other hand, likewise shall be conclusively presumed to have been had or consummated in reliance upon the guarantee contained EGL Guarantee Agreement 5 in this Agreement. The Guarantor waives diligence, presentment, protest, and demand for payment and notice of default or nonpayment to or upon the Borrower or the Guarantor with respect to the Guarantor Obligations. The Guarantor understands and agrees that the guarantee of the Guarantor contained in this Agreement shall be construed as a continuing, absolute and unconditional guarantee of payment and not merely of collection without regard to (i) the validity or enforceability of the Credit Agreement or any other Loan Document, any of the Guarantor Obligations or any other collateral security therefor (including the perfection of such collateral) or guarantee or right of offset with respect thereto at any time or from time to time held by the Facility Agent or any Lender, (ii) any defense, set-off or counterclaim (other than a defense of payment or performance) which may at any time be available to or be asserted by the Borrower or any other Person against the Facility Agent or any Lender, or (iii) any other circumstance whatsoever (with or without notice to or knowledge of the Borrower or the Guarantor) which constitutes, or might be construed to constitute, an equitable or legal discharge of the Borrower for the Borrower Obligations, or of the Guarantor under the guarantee of the Guarantor contained in this Agreement, in bankruptcy or in any other instance. When making any demand hereunder or otherwise pursuing its rights and remedies hereunder against the Guarantor, the Facility Agent may, but shall be under no obligation to, make a similar demand on or otherwise pursue such rights and remedies as it may have against the Borrower, any other Guarantor or any other Person or against any collateral security or guarantee for the Borrower Obligations or any right of offset with respect thereto, and any failure by the Facility Agent to make any such demand, to pursue such other rights or remedies or to collect any payments from the Borrower, any other Guarantor or any other Person or to realize upon any such collateral security or guarantee or to exercise any such right of offset, or any release of the Borrower, any other Guarantor or any other Person or any such collateral security, guarantee or right of offset, shall not relieve the Guarantor of any obligation or liability under this Agreement, and shall not impair or affect the rights and remedies, whether express, implied or available as a matter of law, of the Facility Agent or any Lender against the Guarantor. For the purposes hereof “demand” shall include the commencement and continuance of any legal proceedings.

clauses.name: SECTION 2.06 Reinstatement
clauses.head: SECTION 2.06          Reinstatement. The guarantee contained in
clauses.tail: such payments had not been made.
clauses.text: SECTION 2.06 Reinstatement. The guarantee contained in this Agreement shall continue to be effective, or be reinstated, as the case may be, if at any time payment, or any part thereof, of any of the Guarantor Obligations is rescinded or must otherwise be restored or returned by the Facility Agent or any Lender upon the insolvency, bankruptcy, dissolution, liquidation or reorganization of the Guarantor, or upon or as a result of the appointment of a receiver, intervenor or conservator of, or trustee or similar officer for, the Guarantor or any substantial part of its property, or otherwise, all as though such payments had not been made.

clauses.name: SECTION 2.07 Payments
clauses.head: SECTION 2.07          Payments. The Guarantor hereby guarantees
clauses.tail: without set-off or counterclaim in Dollars.
clauses.text: SECTION 2.07 Payments. The Guarantor hereby guarantees that payments by it hereunder will be paid to the Lenders without set-off or counterclaim in Dollars.

clauses.name: Article III Representations introduction
clauses.head: To induce the Lenders to enter into the
clauses.tail: under the Credit Agreement, that:
clauses.text: To induce the Lenders to enter into the Credit Agreement and to make their respective extensions of credit to the Borrower thereunder, the Guarantor hereby represents and warrants to the Lenders and the Facility Agent on the date hereof, on the Effective Date and on each other date on which representations and warranties are made or deemed made under the Credit Agreement, that:

clauses.name: Article III (a) Organization
clauses.head: (a) The Guarantor (i) is duly organized, validly
clauses.tail: binding upon it or its properties.
clauses.text: (a) The Guarantor (i) is duly organized, validly existing and in good standing under the laws of the jurisdiction of its organization, (ii) has the corporate power and authority, and the legal right, to own and operate its property, to lease the property it operates as lessee and to conduct the business in which it is currently engaged, (iii) is duly qualified as a foreign corporation and in good standing under the laws of each jurisdiction where its ownership, lease or operation of property or the conduct of its business requires such qualification except to the extent the failure to be so qualified could not, in the aggregate, reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect and (iv) is in compliance in all material respects with all laws, regulations and orders of any Governmental Authority applicable to it or its properties and all indentures, agreements and other instruments binding upon it or its properties.

clauses.name: Article III (b) Authority and enforceability
clauses.head: (b) The Guarantor has the corporate power and
clauses.tail: good faith and fair dealing;
clauses.text: (b) The Guarantor has the corporate power and authority, and the legal right, to make, deliver and perform this Agreement and has taken all necessary corporate action to authorize the execution, delivery and performance of this Agreement; no consent or authorization of, filing with, notice to or other act by or in respect of, any Governmental Authority or any other Person is required in connection with the execution, delivery, performance, validity or enforceability of this Agreement; this Agreement has been, and each other Loan Document to which it is a party will be, duly executed and delivered on behalf of the Guarantor; this Agreement constitutes, and each other Loan Document to which it is a party when executed and delivered will constitute, a legal, valid and binding obligation of the Guarantor enforceable against the Guarantor in accordance with its terms, subject to the effects of bankruptcy, insolvency, fraudulent conveyance, reorganization, moratorium and other similar laws relating to or affecting creditors' rights generally, general equitable principles (whether considered in a proceeding in equity or at law) and an implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing;

clauses.name: Article III (c) No conflict
clauses.head: (c) The execution, delivery and performance of this
clauses.tail: except for those already paid;
clauses.text: (c) The execution, delivery and performance of this Agreement (i) will not violate any applicable law or regulation or any order of any Governmental Authority, or violate or result in a default under any indenture, agreement or other instrument binding upon the Guarantor or its assets, except to the extent that any such violations or defaults would not, individually, or in the aggregate, reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect, and (ii) will not result in the creation or imposition of any Lien on any asset of the Guarantor; and there is no requirement on the Guarantor, the Lenders or any Agent to file or pay any stamp duty, registration charges or any other statutory duties and levies except for those already paid;

clauses.name: Article III (d) No litigation
clauses.head: (d) No litigation, investigation or proceeding of or
clauses.tail: result in a Material Adverse Effect;
clauses.text: (d) No litigation, investigation or proceeding of or before any arbitrator or Governmental Authority is pending or, to the knowledge of Guarantor, threatened by or against the Guarantor or against any of its or their respective properties or revenues with respect to this Agreement or any of the transactions contemplated hereby, which would, individually or in the aggregate, reasonably be expect to result in a Material Adverse Effect;

clauses.name: Article III (e) Solvency
clauses.head: (e) On the Effective Date and after giving
clauses.tail: conducted following the Effective Date;
clauses.text: (e) On the Effective Date and after giving effect to the application of the proceeds of any Loans under the Credit Agreement and to all Guarantor Obligations, (a) the fair value of the consolidated assets of the Guarantor, at a fair valuation, will exceed its consolidated debts and liabilities, subordinated, contingent or otherwise; (b) the present fair saleable value of the consolidated property of Guarantor will be greater than the amount that will be required to pay the probable liability of its debts and other liabilities, subordinated, contingent or otherwise, as such consolidated debts and other liabilities become absolute and matured; (c) Guarantor will be able to pay its debts and liabilities, subordinated, contingent or otherwise, as such debts and liabilities become absolute and matured; and (d) Guarantor will not have unreasonably small capital with which to conduct the business in which it is engaged as such business is now conducted and is proposed to be conducted following the Effective Date;

clauses.name: Article III (f) Pari passu ranking
clauses.head: (f) The Guarantor Obligations shall at all time
clauses.tail: senior Indebtedness of the Guarantor;
clauses.text: (f) The Guarantor Obligations shall at all time rank at least pari passu in right of payment in insolvency with all its other present and future senior Indebtedness of the Guarantor;

clauses.name: Article III (g) No director relationships
clauses.head: (g) No governor, director, managing member, manager, or
clauses.tail: senior officer of the Lenders;
clauses.text: (g) No governor, director, managing member, manager, or employee of the Guarantor is a director of a Lender and no director of a Lender holds a substantial Equity Interest in the Guarantor. Except to the extent disclosed in the Disclosed Matters, none of the or governors or managers of the Guarantor is a director of a banking company (as defined under the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 of India) or specified near relation (as specified by the Reserve Bank of India) of a director of a banking company or a near relative of any senior officer of the Lenders;

clauses.name: Article III (h) Willful defaulter; OFAC
clauses.head: (h) In addition to the requirements of Section
clauses.tail: have a place of business in India;
clauses.text: (h) In addition to the requirements of Section 4.13, neither the Guarantor nor any of its governors or managers has been declared to be a willful defaulter under the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 of India. In the event of a Person being identified as a willful defaulter, the Guarantor shall take expeditious and effective steps for the removal of such person as a governor or manager and this obligation shall be a covenant of the Guarantor during the term of this Agreement. Neither the Guarantor nor any of its agents acting or benefitting in any capacity in connection with this Agreement is a Specially Designated National under the sanctions administered by the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) and has not used and shall not use any part of the Facility in any transaction with or for the purpose of financing the activities of any person currently subject to any U.S. sanctions administered by OFAC, including, without limitation, those implemented by regulations codified in Subtitle B, Chapter V of Title 31, U.S. Code of Federal Regulations. The Guarantor is not involved in the business of banking or financial services and/or real estate (as defined in Regulation 2(p) of Notification FEMA 120, dated July 7, 2004 issued by the Reserve Bank of India) nor does it have a place of business in India;

clauses.name: Article III (i) Waiver of immunity
clauses.head: (i) The Guarantor is not entitled in any
clauses.tail: irrevocably waives such immunity;
clauses.text: (i) The Guarantor is not entitled in any jurisdiction in which judicial proceedings may at any time be commenced with respect to this Agreement, to claim for itself or its property, assets or revenues any immunity (whether by reason of sovereignty or otherwise) from suit, jurisdiction of any court, attachment prior to judgment, setoff, execution of a judgment or from any other legal process or remedy, and to the extent that there may be attributed to the Borrower such an immunity (whether or not claimed), and to the extent that the Guarantor may hereafter be entitled to claim such an immunity, the Guarantor hereby irrevocably agrees not to claim and hereby irrevocably waives such immunity;

clauses.name: Article III (j) No Default
clauses.head: (j) No Default in respect of the Guarantor has occurred and is continuing;
clauses.text: (j) No Default in respect of the Guarantor has occurred and is continuing;

clauses.name: Article III (k) Confidential Information Material
clauses.head: (k) The information contained in the Confidential Information
clauses.tail: the Confidential Information Material; and
clauses.text: (k) The information contained in the Confidential Information Material with respect to the Guarantor (other than forecasts, projections, forward-looking information, assumption, conclusions, estimates, and pro forma calculations contained therein) when taken as a whole is true in all material respects as of the date of the Confidential Information Material; provided, however, that with respect to any forecasts, projections, forward-looking information, assumption, conclusions, estimates and pro forma calculations contained therein, the Guarantor represents only that such information regarding the Guarantor was prepared in good faith based upon assumptions believed to be reasonable at the time, and no factual information was omitted from the Confidential Information Material so as to make the Confidential Information Material misleading in any material respect with respect to the Guarantor as of the date of the Confidential Information Material; and

clauses.name: Article III (l) No more favorable guarantee
clauses.head: (l) The Guarantor covenants and agrees with the
clauses.tail: the Guarantor in this Agreement.
clauses.text: (l) The Guarantor covenants and agrees with the Facility Agent and the Lenders that it shall not provide any guarantee or other support in favor of any Project Lender which is not a EGL Guarantee Agreement 8 Lender upon terms and conditions that are substantially more favorable to the beneficiary thereof than as are provided by the Guarantor in this Agreement.

clauses.name: Article III (m) Notice of Default and Material Adverse Effect
clauses.head: (m) Promptly (and not later than five (5)
clauses.tail: Material Adverse Effect on the Guarantor.
clauses.text: (m) Promptly (and not later than five (5) Business Days) after any Responsible Officer of the Guarantor obtains knowledge thereof, Guarantor will furnish to the Lenders or the Facility Agent, on behalf of each Lender written notice of the following: 1. the occurrence of any Default known to the Guarantor, including any material breach of any representation hereunder; 2. any development or event that has or results in, or would reasonably be expected to have or result in, a Material Adverse Effect on the Guarantor.

clauses.name: Article III (n) No disposal of assets
clauses.head: (n) The Guarantor shall not sell or otherwise
clauses.tail: of its assets or properties.
clauses.text: (n) The Guarantor shall not sell or otherwise dispose of, whether by a single transaction or a series of transactions (related or not), any or all of its assets or properties which would materially and adversely affect the ability of such Guarantor to perform its obligations under this Agreement or whose sale or disposition would result in an event which, with the passage of time or the giving of notice or both, would become an Event of Default, provided that the aforesaid restriction shall not apply to an arms length sale or disposal of its assets or properties.

clauses.name: Article III (o) No commission payments
clauses.head: (o) The Borrower shall make no payments to
clauses.tail: accordance with the Credit Agreement.
clauses.text: (o) The Borrower shall make no payments to either Guarantor as a commission or in consideration for the delivery of either Guarantee Agreement on its behalf except from proceeds available from the Unrestricted Account; provided, however, nothing herein shall prevent the Borrower from paying to the Parent dividends, redemptions of capital or to either Guarantor payments in connection with any Unsecured Subordinated Promoter Loans as permitted in accordance with the Credit Agreement.

clauses.name: SECTION 4.01 No Waiver by Course of Conduct; Cumulative Remedies
clauses.head: SECTION 4.01        No Waiver by Course of
clauses.tail: rights or remedies provided by law.
clauses.text: SECTION 4.01 No Waiver by Course of Conduct; Cumulative Remedies. Neither the Facility Agent nor any Lender shall by any act (except by a written instrument pursuant to Section 4.12), delay, indulgence, omission or otherwise be deemed to have waived any right or remedy hereunder or to have acquiesced in any Default or Event of Default or any failure to perform any of the Guarantor Obligations. No failure to exercise, nor any delay in exercising, on the part of the Facility Agent or any Lender, any right, power or privilege hereunder shall operate as a waiver thereof. No single or partial exercise of any right, power or privilege hereunder shall preclude any other or further exercise thereof or the exercise of any other right, power or privilege. A waiver by the Facility Agent or any Lender of any right or remedy hereunder on any one occasion shall not be construed as a bar to any right or remedy which the Facility Agent or such Lender would otherwise have on any future occasion. The rights and remedies herein provided are cumulative, may be exercised singly or concurrently and are not exclusive of any other rights or remedies provided by law.

clauses.name: SECTION 4.02(a) Enforcement Expenses
clauses.head: SECTION 4.02         Enforcement Expenses; Indemnification. (a) The
clauses.tail: disbursements of counsel to the Facility Agent.
clauses.text: SECTION 4.02 Enforcement Expenses; Indemnification. (a) The Guarantor agrees to pay, or reimburse the Facility Agent for, its reasonable costs and expenses incurred in collecting against the Guarantor under the guarantee contained in this Agreement or otherwise enforcing or preserving any rights or obligations under this Agreement, including, without limitation, the reasonable fees and disbursements of counsel to the Facility Agent.

clauses.name: SECTION 4.02(b) Taxes indemnity
clauses.head: (b) The Guarantor agrees to pay, and to
clauses.tail: payable with respect to this Agreement.
clauses.text: (b) The Guarantor agrees to pay, and to save the Facility Agent and the Lenders harmless from, any and all liabilities with respect to, or resulting from any delay in paying, any and all stamp, excise, sales or other taxes which may be payable or determined to be payable with respect to this Agreement.

clauses.name: SECTION 4.02(c) Survival
clauses.head: (c) The agreements in this Section shall survive
clauses.tail: payable under the Credit Agreement.
clauses.text: (c) The agreements in this Section shall survive repayment of the Obligations and all other amounts payable under the Credit Agreement.

clauses.name: SECTION 4.03 Successors and Assigns
clauses.head: SECTION 4.03          Successors and Assigns. This Agreement
clauses.tail: written consent of the Facility Agent.
clauses.text: SECTION 4.03 Successors and Assigns. This Agreement shall be binding upon the successors and assigns of the Guarantor and shall inure to the benefit of the Facility Agent and the Lenders and their successors and assigns; provided that the Guarantor may not assign, transfer or delegate any of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the Facility Agent.

clauses.name: SECTION 4.04 Set-Off
clauses.head: SECTION 4.04        Set-Off. The Guarantor hereby irrevocably
clauses.tail: or such Lender may have.
clauses.text: SECTION 4.04 Set-Off. The Guarantor hereby irrevocably authorizes the Facility Agent and each Lender at any time and from time to time while an Event of Default shall have occurred and be continuing, without notice to the Guarantor or any other Guarantor, any such notice being expressly waived by the Guarantor, to set-off and appropriate and apply any and all deposits (general or special, time or demand, provisional or final), in any currency, and any other credits, indebtedness or claims, in any currency, in each case whether direct or indirect, absolute or contingent, matured or unmatured, at any time held or owing by the Facility Agent or such Lender to or for the credit or the account of the Guarantor, or any part thereof in such amounts as the Facility Agent or such Lender may elect, against and on account of the obligations and liabilities of the Guarantor to the Facility Agent or such Lender hereunder and claims of every nature and description of the Facility Agent or such Lender against the Guarantor, in any currency, whether arising hereunder, under the Credit Agreement, any other Loan Document or otherwise, as the Facility Agent or such Lender may elect, whether or not the Facility Agent or any Lender has made any demand for payment and although such obligations, liabilities and claims may be contingent or unmatured. The Facility Agent and each Lender shall notify the Guarantor promptly of any such set-off and the application made by the Facility Agent or such Lender of the proceeds thereof, provided that the failure to give such notice shall not affect the validity of such set-off and application. The rights of the Facility Agent and each Lender under this Section are in addition to other rights and remedies (including, without limitation, other rights of set-off) which the Facility Agent or such Lender may have.

clauses.name: SECTION 4.05 Counterparts
clauses.head: SECTION 4.05         Counterparts. This Agreement may be
clauses.tail: constitute one and the same instrument.
clauses.text: SECTION 4.05 Counterparts. This Agreement may be executed by one or more of the parties to this Agreement on any number of separate counterparts (including by telecopy), and all of said counterparts taken together shall be deemed to constitute one and the same instrument.

clauses.name: SECTION 4.06 Severability
clauses.head: SECTION 4.06         Severability. Any provision of this
clauses.tail: provision in any other jurisdiction.
clauses.text: SECTION 4.06 Severability. Any provision of this Agreement which is prohibited or unenforceable in any jurisdiction shall, as to such jurisdiction, be ineffective to the extent of such prohibition or unenforceability without invalidating the remaining provisions hereof, and any such prohibition or unenforceability in any jurisdiction shall not invalidate or render unenforceable such provision in any other jurisdiction.

clauses.name: SECTION 4.07 Section Headings
clauses.head: SECTION 4.07          Section Headings. The Section headings
clauses.tail: in the interpretation hereof.
clauses.text: SECTION 4.07 Section Headings. The Section headings used in this Agreement are for convenience of reference only and are not to affect the construction hereof or be taken into consideration in the interpretation hereof.

clauses.name: SECTION 4.08 Integration
clauses.head: SECTION 4.08        Integration. This Agreement and the
clauses.tail: herein or in the other Loan Documents.
clauses.text: SECTION 4.08 Integration. This Agreement and the other Loan Documents represent the agreement of the Guarantor, the Facility Agent and the Lenders with respect to the EGL Guarantee Agreement 10 subject matter hereof and thereof, and there are no promises, undertakings, representations or warranties by the Facility Agent or any Lender relative to subject matter hereof and thereof not expressly set forth or referred to herein or in the other Loan Documents.

clauses.name: SECTION 4.09 GOVERNING LAW
clauses.head: SECTION 4.09  GOVERNING LAW.   THIS AGREEMENT SHALL
clauses.tail: THE LAW OF THE STATE OF NEW YORK.
clauses.text: SECTION 4.09 GOVERNING LAW. THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE GOVERNED BY, AND CONSTRUED AND INTERPRETED IN ACCORDANCE WITH, THE LAW OF THE STATE OF NEW YORK.

clauses.name: SECTION 4.10(a) Submission to Jurisdiction; Venue
clauses.head: (a) The Guarantor hereto irrevocably hereby expressly waives
clauses.tail: brought in any inconvenient forum.
clauses.text: (a) The Guarantor hereto irrevocably hereby expressly waives all right to object to jurisdiction or execution in any legal action or proceeding relating to this Agreement which it may now or hereafter have by reason of its domicile or by reason of any subsequent or other domicile and hereby irrevocably consents that any legal action, suit or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Agreement or any of the Loan Documents and any other document or instrument required to be executed in relation thereto may be instituted in or (other than by the Guarantor) removed to the U.S. federal and New York state courts located in the Borough of Manhattan, City and State of New York, and by execution and delivery of this Agreement, each party hereto submits to and accepts and consents with regard to any such action or proceeding for itself and in respect of its properties and assets, generally and unconditionally, the jurisdiction of any such court. The Guarantor agrees that a judgment in any such action, suit or proceeding may be enforced in any other jurisdiction, including Singapore, by suit upon such judgment, a certified copy of which shall be conclusive evidence of judgment. The Guarantor hereby waives any objection it may now or hereafter have to the laying of the venue of any such action, suit or proceeding, and further waives any claim that any such action, suit or proceeding brought in any of the aforesaid courts has been brought in any inconvenient forum.

clauses.name: SECTION 4.10(b) Process Agent
clauses.head: (b) The Guarantor shall irrevocably designate Essar Americas,
clauses.tail: of the Guarantor may be found.
clauses.text: (b) The Guarantor shall irrevocably designate Essar Americas, Inc., with its office at 277 Park Avenue, 35th Floor, New York, New York 10017, U.S.A., and its successors as the Guarantor’s designee, appointee and agent to receive, accept and acknowledge, for and on behalf of the Guarantor, service of any and all legal process, summons, notices and documents which may be served in such action, suit or proceeding relating to the Credit Agreement, this Agreement or any other Loan Documents in the case of the courts located in the Borough of Manhattan, City and State of New York, which service may be made on any such designee, appointee and agent in accordance with legal procedures prescribed for such courts. So long as the Guarantor has any obligations under this Agreement, the Guarantor agree to take any and all action necessary to continue such designation in full force and effect and should such designee, appointee and agent become unavailable for this purpose for any reason not attributable to the Guarantor, the Guarantor will immediately grant a similar special irrevocable power of attorney to a new designee, appointee and agent with offices in [New York], which shall irrevocably agree to act as such, with the powers and for purposes specified in this Section 4.10. Each of the Guarantor further irrevocably consents and agrees to service of any and all legal process, summons, notices and documents out of any of the aforesaid courts in any such action, suit or proceeding relating to this Agreement or any other Loan Documents delivered to the Guarantor in accordance with this Section 4.10 or to its then designee, appointee or agent for service. If service is made upon such designee, appointee and agent, a copy of such process, summons, notice or document shall also be provided to the Guarantor, by recognized international courier; provided, that failure to provide such copy to the Guarantor shall not impair or affect in any way the validity of such service or any judgment rendered in such action or proceedings. Each of the Guarantor agrees that service upon the Guarantor or any such designee, appointee and agent as provided for herein EGL Guarantee Agreement 11 shall constitute valid and effective personal service upon the Guarantor with respect to matters contemplated in this Section 4.10 and that the failure of any such designee, appointee and agent to give any notice of such service to the Guarantor shall not impair or affect in any way the validity of such service or any judgment rendered in any action or proceeding based thereon. Nothing herein shall limit or be construed to limit the rights of the Lenders to commence proceedings against the Guarantor in any other venue where assets of the Guarantor may be found.

clauses.name: SECTION 4.11 WAIVER OF JURY TRIAL
clauses.head: SECTION 4.11  WAIVER OF JURY TRIAL. EACH
clauses.tail: CREDIT TO THE COMPANY THEREUNDER.
clauses.text: SECTION 4.11 WAIVER OF JURY TRIAL. EACH OF THE PARTIES TO THIS AGREEMENT HEREBY KNOWINGLY, VOLUNTARILY AND INTENTIONALLY WAIVES ANY RIGHT IT MAY HAVE TO A TRIAL BY JURY OF ANY CLAIM, DEMAND OR CAUSE OF ACTION UNDER OR IN CONNECTION WITH THIS AGREEMENT. THIS PROVISION IS A MATERIAL INDUCEMENT FOR THE FACILITY AGENT TO ENTER INTO THIS AGREEMENT AND THE LENDERS TO ENTER INTO THE CREDIT AGREEMENT AND MAKE EXTENSIONS OF CREDIT TO THE COMPANY THEREUNDER.

clauses.head: SECTION 4.12         Notices. All notices, requests, consents,

At Closing, the sum of $8,000,000 (Eight Million Dollars) shall be due and payable to the Seller plus or minus any standard deductions and prorations (customary closing expenses incurred by the Seller inclusive of utility and real estate tax prorations). The remaining balance less any deductions identified below shall be paid to the Seller at a rate of 10% of the annual tax incremental financing reimbursement received by Buyer, For example, the anticipated annual Tax Incremental Financing [TIF] amount is approximately $2,000,000 of which an estimated $200,000 shall be paid to 1200 6"" Street, LLC, annually, and shall become due and payable within thirty (30) days of receipt of same until the remaining $1,000,000 (One Million Dollars) (or less dependent upon setoffs as described below) are received (“Outstanding Balance”). In the event of any taking by the exercise of the power of eminent domain of a substantial portion of the Property prior to Closing (such portion as would impair or otherwise affect the intended use of the Real Property will be deemed substantial). Buyer shall have the right to terminate this Agreement by giving written notice to Seller within ten (10) days after receipt by Buyer of written notification of any such condemnation. If Buyer elects to terminate this Agreement, all awards and compensation arising out of said condemnation shall be the property of Seller. If Buyer fails to give Seller written notice of termination within said ten (10) day period, said right to terminate shall be deemed waived and Buyer shall be credited with or assigned all of Seller's right, title and interest to all awards and compensation arising out of said condemnation, and Buyer shall remain obligated to purchase the Property with no reduction in the Purchase Price. In the event of any taking of an insubstantial portion of the Property prior to the Closing Date (such portion as would not impair or otherwise affect the intended use of the Property will be deemed insubstantial), Seller shall assign to Buyer all of Seller's right, title and interest to all awards and compensation therefore and Buyer shall remain obligated to purchase the Property with no reduction in the Purchase Price.

An integrated approach toward capital planning incorporates not only the immediate needs of an organization, but its long-term goals, and includes variables such as the optimal cost of capitat organizational strategic initiatives requiring investment, desired rating category, and asset liability management. Our Capital Structure Management (CSM) Model is the central tool used in providing this service. The CSM model is a proprietary Monte Carlo simulation-based capital struchlring and optimization system developed specifically for the complex needs of the firm's largest and most prestigious corporate, tax-exempt and sovereign clients. Goldman Sachs also uses the model internally to evaluate debt and investment strategies. Our model provides CFOs and Treasurers with a plan for constructing optimal debt and investment portfolios based upon their cost/risk objectives and existing constraints. clauses.text: 3. The Times and the Union agree that the Contract shall have full force and effect at the Edison, New Jersey by The Times within the Northeast Corridor (Maine te Northern Virginia). Because of the magnitude of the investment in new and rebuilt plants The Times is Planning and its importance to the future of the business and the security of the members of the Union, The Times and the Union are committed to the orderly, successful and efficient start-up and operation of the new and rebuilt plants. The af FUNDO0001070 Times and the Union therefore reaffirm that any dispute concerning the interpretation and application of the Contract, including any dispute concerning the interpretation and application of the Contract at anew or rebuilt facility, shall be resolved through the Contract's grievance and arbitration procedure. Without limiting the disputes to be resolved pursuant to the Contract's grievance and arbitration procedure, the parties intend to resolve all questions that may arise from innovations in methods of operation, as for example operations with palletizing equipment, by discussion and arbitration if necessary, it being understood that notwithstanding the introduction of any such new methods, the Contract will continue to protect regular situation holders against layoffs for the term of the Contract because of the introduction of automated processes. The Times agrees that all such protected regular situation holders shall be listed by name on the date of ratification and on the date of the commencement of built facility. With respect to a eee Ee i ot ate é ae at tae he & erations at any ne the commencement of operations at any new or rebuilt facility, every effort shall be made to place employees in jobs most nearly equivalent to the work peformed in current operations. It is further agreed that to the extent practicable regular situation holders engaged in advance product production at Carlstadt shall constitute the initial work force at Edison. if FUNDOO001071 | « : ok ‘ In connection with any arbitration concerning the interpretation and application of the Contract at @ new or rebuilt facility, the arbitrator shall issue his award before operations commence. Should the arbitrator fail to issue his award before operations at a new or rebuilt facility begin, operations shall commence under operating conditions established in an interim ruling by the arbitrator and shall continue thus until the arbitrator issues his award. Upon the written request of either party, the parties agree to attempt to resolve any issues under | this paragraph prior to arbitration through non-binding mediation by a mutually agreed upon mediator. The use of mediation shall not delay any arbitration proceeding on any euch issues.

clauses.text: (b) Upon agreeing to enter into a Transaction hereunder, Buyer or Seller (or both), as shall be agreed, shall promptly deliver to the other party a written confirmation of each Transaction (a “Confirmation”). The Confirmation shall describe the Purchased Securities (including CUSIP number, if any), identify Buyer and Seller and set forth (i) the Purchase Date, (ii) the Purchase Price, (iii) the Repurchase Date, unless the Transaction is to be terminable on demand, (iv) the Pricing Rate or Repurchase Price applicable to the Transaction, and (v) any additional terms or conditions of the Transaction not inconsistent with this Agreement. The Confirmation, together with this Agreement, shall constitute conclusive evidence of the terms agreed between Buyer and Seller with respect to the Transaction to which the Confirmation relates, unless with respect to the Confirmation specific objection is made promptly after receipt thereof. In the event of any conflict between the terms of such Confirmation and this Agreement, this Agreement shall prevail.

The Liquidating Trust shall be established for the purpose of implementation of the Plan by liquidating the Trust Assets and distributing the proceeds to holders of Liquidating Trust Interests, in accordance with Treasury Regulations Section 301.7701-4(d), with no objective to continue or engage in the conduct of a trade or business. Accordingly, the Trustee shall, in an expeditious but orderly manner, liquidate and convert to cash the Trust Assets of the Liquidating Trust, make timely distributions and not unduly prolong the duration of the Liquidating Trust. The liquidation of the Trust Assets may be accomplished either through the sale of Trust Assets (in whole or in combination), including the sale of any rights of action, or through the prosecution or settlement of any rights of action, or otherwise.

Notwithstanding any bylaws or other agreements to the contrary, the Committee shall conduct business by vote of the majority in number of the members of the Committee constituting a quorum. A quorum shall be: (1) three members of the Committee; or (2) if the number of members is reduced to three or fewer, all members of the Committee. A meeting of the Committee may be convened by the chairperson of the Committee or the Trustee upon reasonable notice, transmitted by means reasonable under the circumstances, including email. A meeting may be held in person at any location reasonable under the circumstances or by telephone conference. The Trustee may obtain the Committee’s approval for any action by email, without a meeting, provided that the Trustee shall notify {00606926204 41M9803 Doc# 101-1 File4: 12/21/11 Entered: 12/21/11 16:54:26 Page 8 of 19 each member of the Committee by email of her request for approval, and approval shall be deemed to have been provided pursuant to majority vote upon the Trustee’s receipt of return emails from at least a quorum of the members after a period of time reasonable under the circumstances. If the Trustee determines, in her sole discretion, that a meeting of the Committee should be held or approval should be obtained on an emergency basis, the Trustee shall be entitled to convene a meeting of the Committee upon 24-hours’ notice, and the Trustee shall be entitled to obtain approval by email upon 24~-hours’ notice.

Nothing in this Trust Agreement provides any holder with a right to review, inspect, seek discovery of or otherwise obtain any information that is privileged or subject to a third party’s rights of privacy or confidentiality.

The Trustee shall, in an expeditious but orderly manner, liquidate and convert to cash the Trust Assets, make timely distributions and not unduly prolong the duration of the Liquidating Trust. Under section 1145 of the Bankruptcy Code, the issuance of Liquidating Trust Interests under the Plan shall be exempt from registration under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and applicable state and local laws requiring registration of securities, if applicable. If the Trustee determines that the Liquidating Trust is required to comply with the registration and reporting or other requirements of the Securities and Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, or the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended, then the Trustee shall take any and all actions to comply with, or qualify for exemption from, such reporting or other requirements and to file periodic reports with the Securities and Exchange Commission as necessary.

clauses.name: 6.2 Tax Reporting
clauses.head: 6.2 Tax Reporting. Promptly following the end of
clauses.tail: applicable administrative and judicial authorities and pronouncements.
clauses.text: 6.2 Tax Reporting. Promptly following the end of each calendar year, the Trustee shall submit to each holder of a Liquidating Trust Interest appearing on the Register during such year a separate statement setting forth the holder’s share of items of income, gain, loss, deduction or credit and will instruct all such holders to report such items on their federal income tax returns. Allocations of Liquidating Trust taxable income shall be determined by reference to the manner in which an amount of cash equal to such taxable income would be distributed (without regard to any restrictions on distributions described herein or in the Plan or Disclosure Statement) if, immediately prior to such deemed distribution, the Liquidating Trust had distributed all of its other assets (valued for this purpose at their tax book value) to the holders of Liquidating Trust Interests, taking into account all prior and concurrent distributions from the Liquidating Trust. Similarly, taxable loss of the Liquidating Trust shall be allocated by reference to the manner in which an economic loss would be borne immediately after a liquidating distribution of the remaining Trust Assets. For this purpose, the tax book value of the Trust Assets shall equal their fair market value on the Effective Date or, if later, the date such assets were acquired by the Liquidating Trust, adjusted in either case in accordance with tax accounting principles prescribed by the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, the Treasury Regulations and other applicable administrative and judicial authorities and pronouncements.
